config.name: Tywi Estuary
config._note: Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD), no check gauges. Tide from Mumbles, 35.0 km from the estuary mouth (a stand-in gauge). River flows: NRW 15-minute levels converted to flow with a daily level-flow relation from the National River Flow Archive (needs an NRW key in settings.json; otherwise the default base flow is used). Tidal limit position is approximate.
